sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美西语近岸软件研发外包与数字客服中心

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture of Aseptic Barista-Formula Hydrolyzed Oat Milk

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Colombia (unitary national jurisdiction; no sub-state business registry or tax differentiation)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (codified Roman-Germanic tradition; statutory commercial and administrative law under the Codigo de Comercio, Decree 410 of 1971, and Law 1258 of 2008)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia-United States Trade Promotion Agreement (in force 2012, investment chapter)
Pacific Alliance Framework Agreement with Mexico, Peru and Chile (in force 2011)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 526 of 1999 (UIAF) as amended by Law 1121 of 2006 and Law 2195 of 2022; Decree 830 of 2021 (Registro Unico de Beneficiarios Finales - RUB, administered by DIAN); Decree 1068 of 2015 (single regulatory decree for the finance sector); Superintendencia de Sociedades Circular Externa 100-000005 of 2014 (SAGRILAFT); Law 1258 of 2008 (S.A.S.); Codigo de Comercio (Decree 410 of 1971).
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (RUB filings are submitted exclusively to DIAN and the UIAF and are not open to the general public)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Good Standing of the foreign corporate shareholder (Certificado de Existencia y Representacion Legal)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry of the shareholder's jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Convention of 5 October 1961, acceded by Colombia and in force since 2001); consular legalization required only if the origin state is not an Apostille Convention member

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), Código de Comercio arts. 110-124, Decreto 1023 de 2012 as amended, and Resolución 2674 de 2013 for food-industry infrastructure
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá / Registro Único Empresarial (RUES); Superintendencia de Sociedades for post-incorporation oversight
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation instrument) with by-laws, filed with the Formulario de Registro Único Empresarial
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum for the S.A.S.; the by-laws set the subscribed capital, and contributions must be fully paid within two years of registration. Foreign shareholders may subscribe in foreign currency, subject to exchange declarations before the Banco de la República; no escrow account is mandated by law.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the authorized, subscribed and paid capital of the Company is hereby acknowledged and allocated to the registered office, production plant and operational needs of the corporate purpose; RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office is established at [Carrera 45 No. 123-45], Bogotá D.C., Colombia; RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name] is appointed President and Legal Representative, and [Name] is appointed Secretary, with the powers conferred by law and the by-laws; RESOLVED FURTHER, that the President is authorized to execute the incorporation filings with the Chamber of Commerce and DIAN, to obtain the NIT, to open a corporate bank account, and to sign first contracts; RESOLVED, that all acts performed by the incorporators are hereby ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Availability Certificate and Corporate Name Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá — Registro Único Empresarial (RUES), www.rue.com.co
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name search application with two alternative corporate names via the RUES portal; upon certification that the proposed denomination is not reserved, obtain the Certificado de Homogeneidad and reserve the name for up to 30 days.
required_dossiers: Name search form (Formulario de Búsqueda de Homogeneidad)
Power of attorney if filing through an agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is already reserved to another entity, select a fallback name and re-apply; the first re-submission carries no additional fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Private Incorporation Instrument and By-laws
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public for notarized signatures; direct execution by incorporators for private form
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Documento Privado de Constitución under Ley 1258 de 2008, including name, corporate purpose, CIIU code 1050, capital subscription and payment terms, administration provisions, and fiscal year. Execute before a notary if shareholders act through an attorney or if real estate is contributed; otherwise sign in private form. Record shareholder acceptance to pay capital contributions within two years of registration.
required_dossiers: Draft by-laws and capital subscription schedule
Identification and RUT of each shareholder
Notarized power of attorney for foreign or non-resident incorporators
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary objects to by-law clauses, the statute is amended and the instrument re-executed; a corrected private document supersedes the invalidated clause and is initialed by all incorporators.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registry Registration with the Chamber of Commerce (RUES)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá — Chamber of Commerce registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed private incorporation document together with Formulario RUES and pay the registration tariff calculated on subscribed capital. Upon successful registration, the Chamber issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal, which vests legal personality and legal representation powers.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Registration is effective as of the filing date; if the Chamber issues a 'deficiencia' notice, correct deficiencies within 15 days; failure to cure within one month requires a new filing and additional tariff.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Taxpayer Registration and NIT Obtainment with DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN — Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales, portal www.dian.gov.co
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the Formulario de Registro Único Tributario (RUT) online; obtain the NIT assigned electronically; declare CIIU code 1050 as primary economic activity; register for income tax, VAT, and electronic invoicing (facturación electrónica). Update the RUT within 60 days of any subsequent change.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal from Chamber of Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RUT application is rejected due to an address mismatch, correct the municipal address and revalidate with the Chamber certificate; a disputed blacklisting of the legal representative is appealed before the DIAN tax office within 10 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Industrial and Commerce Registration (ICA) and Land Use Compatibility
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Secretaría Distrital de Hacienda for ICA; Secretaría de Planeación for zoning
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register with the Registro de Industria y Comercio for the industrial manufacturing activity at the plant address; obtain the Certificate of Land Use Compatibility (Concepto de Uso del Suelo) confirming that the production plant is permitted in the industrial zone; enroll with the municipal sanitation tax registry where applicable.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Lease or ownership deed for plant premises
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the zoning concept is negative, the company may apply for a municipal patent against the zoning decision before the planning authority, or propose an alternative industrial site within the recommended zone.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Bank Account Opening and Employer Social Security Enrollment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial banking institution; ARL, EPS, and AFP administrators; Ministry of Labor portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate checking account under the new NIT; provide the board resolution and legal representative identification; complete the UBO declaration for AML purposes under the low-risk standard and obtain receiving-bank details for Swift LC and TT Wire transactions; enroll the company as employer with EPS, AFP, and ARL, and register the workplace in the Sistema General de Riesgos Laborales.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests additional background documentation under the four-twenty AML rule, provide the corporate UBO statement and source-of-funds declaration; ARL enrollment conflicts are resolved by re-submission of payroll registration through the Ministry of Labor portal.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: INVIMA — Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos (National Food and Drug Surveillance Institute)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registro Sanitario de Alimentos (Sanitary Registration for processed food) plus Concepto Sanitario Favorable (favorable sanitary concept) for the physical plant, both required under Resolución 2674 de 2013 and Decreto 2478 de 2018

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: ANLA — Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales, with the local Corporación Autónoma Regional for discharge and emission permits
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category IV — Environmental Registration with an Environmental Management Plan (no full EIA monograph); mandatory wastewater discharge permit (Permiso de Vertimientos) and atmospheric emissions permit (Permiso de Emisiones Atmosféricas) for the boiler and UHT generation equipment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Resolución 0631 de 2015 effluent limits for the food sector: pH 6.0-9.0, BOD5 <= 800 mg/l, COD <= 1500 mg/l, TSS <= 700 mg/l, fats and oils <= 20 mg/l; Resolución 2254 de 2017 national air quality standards: PM10 <= 75 microg/m3 and PM2.5 <= 50 microg/m3 over 24 hours, SO2 <= 250 microg/m3; odor control for CIP and oat-residue streams, with thermal destruction of VOC emissions from aseptic processing under the national emission factor method.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety: Certificado de Bomberos issued under Ley 1575 de 2012 after inspection of extinguishers, escape routes, and hydrants; structural load clearance: municipal building occupancy license (Licencia de Ocupación) and structural review of the production plant; occupational: SST (Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo) Program, employer registration with the ARL, medical aptitude examinations, and constitution of the COPASST joint committee.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Unidad Administrativa Especial Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN), Colombia; official portal: https://www.dian.gov.co; electronic transaction platform: DIAN services portal and Ventanilla Única de Comercio Exterior (VUCE).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A resident S.A.S. is assigned its NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) upon incorporation. The practical sequence is: (i) execute corporate bylaws and appoint the legal representative; (ii) register the S.A.S. with the Cámara de Comercio through the Registro Único Empresarial (RUES); (iii) complete the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) before DIAN online, selecting ISIC 1050, VAT responsible status under the régimen común, income tax responsibilities, and withholding responsibilities; (iv) activate electronic invoicing through an authorized facturador or DIAN’s platform. A purely foreign entity that itself has Colombian taxable nexus, such as conducting imports, exports, or rendering taxable services to Colombian recipients, must appoint an authorized representative with notarized and apostilled powers, file the RUT with the foreign entity’s corporate data, and obtain its own NIT; no local incorporation is required for that representative function.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation. The Colombian S.A.S. is a resident legal entity taxed on worldwide income under the Colombian Tax Statute; it is not eligible for pass-through or look-through treatment. A permanent establishment of a foreign corporation is similarly taxed at entity/PE level; no territorial election is available.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election exists in Colombian law. The only elective regime relevant to classification is adherence to the Régimen Simple de Tributación (SIMPLE) for eligible taxpayers with previous-year gross ordinary income not exceeding 100,000 UVT; that election produces an integrated presumptive tax. Hybrid mismatch rules under Law 2277/2022 operate automatically and do not confer an elective entity-classification choice; an S.A.S. cannot elect to be disregarded.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA – Impuesto sobre las Ventas (VAT), with the national customs and consumption tax framework under Decree 1625/2016.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: None for legal persons: an S.A.S. must register as a VAT responsible taxpayer under the régimen común from its first taxable transaction or importation, regardless of turnover. Colombian law imposes no monetary threshold for companies. Natural persons eligible for the simplified VAT regime are not separately liable where prior-year gross income is below 3,500 UVT and gross assets are below 4,500 UVT, approximately COP 164.7 million and COP 211.8 million respectively at the 2024 UVT of COP 47,065; this threshold does not apply to the S.A.S.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory national e-invoicing: each VAT-responsible seller must issue the Factura Electrónica de Venta (FEV) with DIAN pre-validation. The XML invoice is transmitted in real time through DIAN web services using an API secured with OAuth2 and a digital certificate; DIAN returns a CUFE or CUDE cryptographic stamp and a QR code that must be displayed on the paper or PDF representation. The invoice is deemed legally issued only after DIAN accepts the XML. For export sales, the electronic export invoice and supporting transport and customs documents must be integrated into the same clearance flow.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible goods, including packaged UHT oat milk, are zero-rated under Article 481 of the Colombian Tax Statute when the seller sells to a non-resident purchaser and the goods physically leave Colombia’s customs territory under a valid export declaration. Zero-rating also applies to exported services rendered to non-residents for use exclusively abroad when the services do not generate Colombian-source income. The producer must hold export contracts, electronic export invoices, customs authorization, sanitary export certificates for food, transport evidence, and must repatriate export proceeds through the Colombian foreign-exchange market.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: DIAN-accepted Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación - DEX) and electronic export invoice (Factura Electrónica de Exportación)
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill / Cargo Manifest evidencing physical exit of the goods from Colombian customs territory
Inward Remittance Certificate (Comprobante de Reintegro de Divisas) or SWIFT credit advice evidencing collection within the mandatory period
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN and the customs authority cross-check the electronic export declaration, FEV, transport documents, and foreign-exchange intervention reports. If an export zero-rating claim is rejected, the S.A.S. must pay 19% retroactive VAT on the export price plus daily late-payment interest under Article 635 of the Tax Statute, and is exposed to the inaccurate-return penalty under Article 647, which may reach 100% of the tax difference in fraud-like cases. Customs fines and forfeiture for false or incomplete export declarations apply under Decree 1165/2019, and criminal liability may arise if export documentation is wilfully false. VAT refunds already received are clawed back with indexation and penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (Central Bank of Colombia), acting through the Departamento de Cambios Internacionales (Foreign Exchange Department), the Junta Directiva (Board of Directors), and the Regulación Cambiaria framework issued under Law 9 of 1991, Decree 1735 of 1993, Decree 1068 of 2015, Resolución Externa No. 1 of 2018 (as amended by Resolución Externa No. 2 of 2023), and Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83. The Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) supervises all authorized foreign exchange intermediaries and banking institutions, while the Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) enforces the customs and tax interface for foreign trade settlements.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia maintains a managed-float regime for the Colombian Peso (COP) with full convertibility of foreign exchange for transactions settled through the regulated 'mercado cambiario' (foreign exchange market). Current-account operations, including export of the aseptic barista-formula hydrolyzed oat milk units, imports of packaging raw materials, machinery, royalties, and freight, are freely convertible but must be 'canalizadas' (channeled) through authorized intermediaries with a formal 'declaración de cambio' filed with Banco de la República. Capital-account inflows, including direct foreign investment in the Colombian S.A.S., are permitted without prior government approval, but must be registered with Banco de la República within 12 months of the effective disbursement date to perfect the investor's legal right to remit dividends and repatriate invested capital. Profit remittances by a non-resident shareholder of the S.A.S. are lawful after (i) registration of the investment, (ii) payment of corporate income tax and the applicable dividend withholding tax (generally 5% for distributions to non-resident shareholders of Colombian-source earnings, subject to treaty limitations), and (iii) presentation of the exchange declaration. Practical hurdles include: inability to remit dividends if the investment registration is not legalized ahead of the distribution; mandatory conversion of foreign currency at TRM-disciplined market rates through a local bank; liquidity frictions for very large USD/COP spot trades during periods of central-bank discretionary intervention; and strict anti-money-laundering compliance reviews before any profit distribution is processed.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Colombia imposes no percentage-based mandatory conversion (surrender) ratio on export proceeds, but it does impose a 100% 'canalización' rule: all foreign currency proceeds from exports of goods, including UHT oat milk beverages classified under ISIC 1050 / HS 2202, must be channeled through the foreign exchange market by either selling the currency to an authorized intermediary, crediting it to a locally-held foreign-currency account, or depositing it into a 'cuenta de compensación' (compensation account) abroad. The statutory timing under Resolución Externa No. 1 of 2018 is: the exporter must collect the proceeds within the payment period agreed in the underlying contract, which generally cannot exceed 6 months from the date of the export customs declaration for standard open-account trade; if a longer commercial payment period is agreed, the proceeds must be collected and channeled by the contractual due date, and in all cases no later than 12 months from export, unless Banco de la República grants an exceptional extension. Funds credited to an offshore compensation account must be repatriated into the Colombian financial system within 4 months of the date of receipt in that account. Each export operation must be declared on Formulario No. 2 (Declaración de Cambio por Exportación de Bienes) presented through the local commercial bank, and failure to channel within the applicable deadline carries exchange-control penalties including fines, forced sale of the currency, and loss of the exporter's VAT-refund (IVA a favor) benefits on exported goods.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.domestic_market_and_customer_scope: The treasury blueprint is designed for a Colombia-based S.A.S. whose commercial scope comprises plant-based beverage manufacturing for both the domestic Colombian market and export markets across Latin America, the Caribbean, the United States, and the European Union, with target payment rails for letters of credit (LC) and telegraphic transfers (TT).

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Current Account in COP with a dual-currency sub-account in USD (Cuenta en Moneda Extranjera) and a Capital Escrow / Foreign Investment Registration sub-account
Capital Escrow Account for Foreign Investment (Cuenta de Inversión) plus Operational USD/COP Current Account with integrated foreign trade desk
Operational Current Account in COP with USD foreign-currency account and trade-finance limit for documentary LCs
Operational Account in COP/USD with cash-management portal and cross-border web wire capabilities
Operational Current Account and Foreign-Currency Account for trade settlement with a dedicated international banking unit

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW for using offshore fintech EMIs (for example Wise Business, Airwallex, Currencycloud, or NIUM) as the primary treasury gateway of the Colombian S.A.S. Colombian exchange control obligates all capital injections, export collection, import payments, and profit remittances to pass through authorized 'mercado cambiario' intermediaries supervised by the SFC, and an unlicensed offshore EMI cannot file exchange declarations, cannot hold the company's NIT-linked regulatory records, and cannot issue the 'declaración de cambio' documentation that Banco de la República requires. Funds arriving at the local bank through an EMI's umbrella clearing account are visible as third-party settlements, which can create source-of-funds opacity and jeopardize the registerable 'inversión extranjera' status of an equity injection. Legal constraints equally affect the outbound side: payments to overseas suppliers settled through an offshore EMI netting engine are not recognized as 'canalización' and expose the company to exchange penalties. Recommended approach: open and maintain the primary corporate accounts at Bancolombia S.A. and Banco de Bogotá S.A.; use regulated domestic fintech rails (including SEDPEs such as Nubank Colombia, ePayco, or Wompi) for low-value collections from e-commerce distribution channels; and engage an SFC-licensed FX broker or bank for all foreign-currency conversions. An offshore EMI may only act as an ancillary payables rail for very low-value SaaS subscriptions or global R&D cost recharges, capped at 20% of monthly operational disbursements, with complete reconciliation of MT103 records retained to evidence the underlying treasury flow.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding of the Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada (S.A.S.) is legally permissible, but current Colombian banking practice requires that the legal representative and each ultimate beneficial owner holding more than 5% participate in at least one SFC-compliant 'entrevista de conocimiento del cliente' (client due-diligence interview), which may be conducted by video conference and followed by a physical verification meeting at the designated bank branch for the legal representative or the holder of a notarized 'poder especial' (special power of attorney) to sign the account contract and register specimen signatures. Colombian banks generally mandate one in-person signature ceremony at the branch for the first account opening, especially when the UBOs are non-resident foreign shareholders; a fully digital 'e-firma' process is accepted only for pre-approved corporate clients and for subsequent additional accounts after the first account has been operational for at least 12 months. Required documentary bundle: (i) certificate of existence and legal representation issued by the local Chamber of Commerce within 30 days before opening; (ii) notarized and apostilled bylaws (estatutos sociales) of the S.A.S.; (iii) notarized board/shareholders' resolution appointing the legal representative and UBO declaration; (iv) RUT (Registro Único Tributario) certificate confirming the NIT; (v) passport copies of non-resident UBOs or 'cédula de extranjería' where applicable; (vi) SARLAFT questionnaires; (vii) source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statements; and (viii) bank reference letters from the parent company's home bank for the past 12 months. A genuine physical-presence mandate arises from the bank's SARLAFT manual rather than from statute; however, where the principal foreign shareholder has no Colombian operational footprint, a senior director should present in Bogotá to accelerate compliance approval.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO jurisdiction exposure: the ultimate beneficial owner or coordinating shareholder is domiciled in a FATF high-risk or monitored jurisdiction, or is a trust/offshore vehicle lacking commercial substance, which triggers the Colombian bank's 'country risk matrix' under SARLAFT chapter 4.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full UBO chain disclosure with ownership tracing down to natural persons even below the standard 25% threshold; apostilled certificates of good standing and corporate registries of all intermediate entities; evidence of the operating business of the shareholder, including financial statements for the last two years and bank reference letters; sworn source-of-wealth affidavit with underlying transaction documentation (sale purchase agreement, inheritance documents, certified funds in regulated financial institutions); and an explanatory business-case letter demonstrating how the foreign shareholder adds value to the Colombian UHT oat milk plant operation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatched corporate purpose: the S.A.S. declares aseptic beverage manufacturing under ISIC 1050 but the KYC profile shows no physical plant, no import records, and high-volume treasury flows in the first 6 months, which the compliance officer may flag as a 'pantalla operativa' (shell operating entity).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized lease or ownership deed of the production facility; municipal industrial zoning permit and the 'Registro Sanitario' / sanitary approval issued by INVIMA for the UHT oat milk line; technical equipment invoices for the sterilizer, aseptic filler, homogenizer, and packaging line; supplier contracts from Lactalis, Tetra Pak, or equivalent original equipment manufacturers; payroll records and PILA social-security contributions for production staff; utility bills showing industrial electricity, steam, and water consumption; HACCP and ISO 22000 certification of the plant; and a declared pre-operating capex schedule aligned with the capital injection.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: PEP sensitivity: a legal representative or UBO holds current or recent public office, senior public-sector banking employment, or contracting authority with Colombian state entities, elevating the account to a higher-risk classification and requiring enhanced continuous monitoring.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: PEP questionnaire for the designated person using the bank's 'Sagrilaft' module; sworn declaration of no nexus between public funds and the private investment; certified personal bank statements showing the lawful accumulation of the investment capital; tax returns of the PEP UBO for the past three years; a detailed written statement of the investment rationale for the oat milk plant, including the commercial feasibility study and supply-chain contracts; and written consent to increased transaction monitoring and annual re-certification of PEP status.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Anomalous FX and wire pattern: the proposed treasury route includes round-trip USD/COP wires, rapid in-and-out of shareholder loans in the first 90 days, or reliance on third-party payments to unnamed brokers, agents, or tolling processors, which banks under Circular DCIN-83 treat as indicators of unreported external credit or currency exchange evasion.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Fully signed commercial contracts and purchase orders; export LCs and import documentation matched to DIAN customs declarations; freight forwarder documents (B/L, AWB) evidencing physical cargo flows; tax invoices (CUFE/CUDE electronically issued) for each transaction; a treasury policy letter signed by the CFO describing working-capital cycles and loan repayment schedules; bank credit notes for previous legitimate remittances; and a pre-emptive no-objection meeting with the bank's 'oficina de riesgos' presenting projected monthly FX volumes and repayment calendars.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol for the initial foreign equity injection: (1) execute the capital increase of the Colombian S.A.S. through a notarial or privately-legalized shareholders' deed and update the capital registry at the Chamber of Commerce; (2) ensure the foreign parent remits the equity contribution via SWIFT MT103 using an account in the parent's name at a reputable correspondent bank, naming the Colombian S.A.S. as beneficiary with NIT identification and purpose-of-payment code aligned to 'Inversión directa de capital' (Formulario No. 5, Declaración de Cambio por Inversiones Internacionales); (3) the receiving bank will request submission of the investment declaration within 5 business days of the value date, together with the board resolution authorizing the capital increase, UBO registry, and evidence of viability of the UHT plant project; (4) Banco de la República's Foreign Exchange Department registers the investment and the bank issues the 'certificado de inversión', which is the controlling document for all future dividend remittances and capital repatriation; (5) if the injection is structured as a shareholder loan, the inflow must be classified as 'financiamiento externo' with a monetary maturity embedded in the exchange declaration, and the company must segregate and report interest at rates aligned to OECD transfer-pricing rules; (6) all FX conversion from USD/EUR to COP is executed at the negotiable TRM, with no obligations to convert beyond the market channel privileges; (7) verification layer: the remitter bank name must match the signature of the equity subscription, error in remitter name is the most frequent cause of returned or suspended capital inflows.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The S.A.S. UHT plant disbursement rails are structured as follows: (a) Import of raw materials (aseptic carton rolls, oxygen-barrier films, aluminum lids, oat flour, enzyme preparations): pay via SWIFT MT103/TT with 30% advance and 70% against presentation of the bill of lading, each remittance quoting the import's DIAN customs declaration number and the Formulario No. 1 exchange declaration attached; (b) Capital equipment and engineering services for the plant: finance through irrevocable documentary Letters of Credit issued under UCP 600 by Bancolombia or Banco de Bogotá, at sight or usance, with confirmation by a top-tier EU/US bank if seller insists, covering 100% of the CIP/FOB contract value; (c) Royalties and technology licensing to the foreign licensor: remit via TT/MT103 with the corresponding withholding tax certificate (generally 15% on royalties, or 10% where the license is registered with the Colombian National Copyright and Patent Office, SIC), using the purpose-of-payment code for 'regalías' and an exchange declaration; (d) Domestic Colombian disbursements (payroll, Colombian distributors, utilities, municipal taxes): route through the local ACH 'CUD' (Compensación Electrónica de Pagos) / PSE rails in COP with same-day or T+1 settlement; (e) Export collections from Latin America, EU, and US buyers: require MT103 remittances quoting the invoice and the import/export reference number, collection under documentary drafts (URC 522) for growth accounts, and standby LCs for substitutes or new distributors; the Colombian treasury desk should concentrate USD inflows in a foreign-currency account at Bancolombia and effect a spot conversion to COP only when operational liquidity is required, preserving the legal 'canalización' status of the proceeds; (f) FX settlement discipline: all legacy bank-to-bank transactions use SWIFT MT202/MT205 for correspondent onward funding, and the company must strictly avoid netting of export and import invoices in a single wire because Colombian exchange control treats each leg as an independent obligation.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable OTC FX Forwards (USD/COP) transacted through Banco de la República authorized intermediaries, with tenors up to 24 months and physical settlement at the negotiated forward TRM; used to lock the local-currency equivalent of hard-currency trade receivables.
FX Swaps (USD/COP) combining a spot near-leg and a forward far-leg, typically with the local bank as the only counterparty and collateralized by cash margins or equivalent bank guarantees.

Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) on USD/COP for foreign shareholders and for locally-registered borrowers, quoted against the 12:30 p.m. Colombia TRM fixing and settled net in USD; permissible where the bank does not require physical delivery and the underlying exposure is documented in the exchange declaration.

Cross-Currency Interest Rate Swaps (USD vs COP) matching floating-rate foreign debt service (SOFR) against the local IBR (Banco de la República indicative rate) or fixed COP coupon, permitted for the project finance layer financing the UHT plant.

Plain-Vanilla European FX Options (USD/COP call and put) purchased for insurance-type premium hedging of capital-equipment capex and export receivables, with premium payments non-speculative and limited to declared treasury exposure.

Commodity price swap overlays on oat, packaging polymer, and aluminum-linked exposures, executed by the bank's commodity derivatives desk as a residual hedge not exceeding 20% of the fixed procurement exposure of the plant.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Commercial Registry Renewal (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before March 31 of each calendar year, based on business registration anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing surcharge of 10% of the renewal fee for the first month, plus 1.5% monthly interest; continued non-renewal may lead to temporary closure and administrative strike-off from the commercial registry.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statements Filing (Estados Financieros) with the Commercial Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Must be filed by March 31 of the following fiscal year for the preceding year (uniform deadline for all entities)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to 25 times the current legal minimum monthly wage (approx. USD 6,400) for non-filing; repeated failure may trigger administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Owner Report (Reporte de Beneficiario Final)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Unidad de Información y Análisis Financiero (UIAF) via the Chamber of Commerce platform
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within 30 calendar days after the tenth month of the fiscal year (typically by November 9 for calendar-year filers)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to 26.66 times the minimum wage (approx. USD 7,000) for non-compliance; criminal liability for deliberate misrepresentation.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada (S.A.S.) is required to appoint a statutory auditor (Revisor Fiscal) if it is a public-interest entity, exceeds 5,000 minimum monthly wages in total assets (approx. USD 1.3 million as of 2025), has gross annual revenues over 3,000 minimum monthly wages (approx. USD 760,000), or if the shareholders holding at least 20% of the equity request one.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian Financial Reporting Standards (NIIF / NFPS), fully aligned with IFRS for the classification of entity size (Group 1, 2, or 3) determined by the Decreto 2420 de 2015.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The S.A.S. must annually confirm its ultimate beneficial owner(s) through the UIAF's Beneficial Owner System, identifying any natural person holding 5% or more of shares, voting rights, or control. Shareholding transfers made during the year must be reported in the register and reflected in the annual UBO confirmation; failure to update is a separate offense.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Register of Directors (Libro de Junta Directiva)
Minute Book (Libro de Actas de Asamblea de Accionistas)
Register of Shareholders' Attendance and Voting Powers

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,000 - USD 6,500 annually depending on complexity

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% (tarifa general del impuesto sobre la renta, Article 240 E.T., applicable for FY2025)
